findings.better: play GD02-058 Ryusei-Go (Graze Custom II) [2 cost] (deploy: 1 damage to itself, draw 1, discard 1), optionally pairing GD05-117 Become a Shield as a linked Tekkadan pilot
findings.reason: P0 had no units against P1's GM and Guncannon+Sleggar, 9 cards in hand and nothing it could use at instant speed (Become a Shield needs a friendly unit to be castable). Ryusei-Go is affordable, filters a card, gives a body that can attack rested units next turn and makes Become a Shield castable in P1's action step. Passing wasted the whole turn's resources for no gain.

findings.played: end_main without attacking with the active ST01-005 GM
findings.better: attack the player with GM to destroy the Isaribi base (HP1/5)
findings.reason: P0 had no units or blockers, so the GM attack would remove the base one turn earlier (effectively one extra hit) while P1 kept 3 resources and Unforeseen Incident open. The only cost is the GM being rested and attackable by a linked unit next turn, hence arguable.

findings.played: attack the rested GD05-058 Shiden Custom (6/4) with GD01-001 Gundam (AP4, HP3); both were destroyed
findings.better: send every unit at the player (ST01-001+Amuro AP6 through Isaribi, then two shields, then the final hit)
findings.reason: P0 had 0 active resources and Shiden was rested, so it could not block; lethal needed 4 attacks and P1 had 6 attackers. Spending one (and losing it) on a unit that could not affect this turn cut the spare attackers from 2 to 1 against a Burst on P0's two shields (P0's Tekkadan deck had already shown two Isaribi, whose Burst deploys a fresh 5-HP base). P1 still won, so arguable.

items.notes: Other decisions judged reasonable: P1 used Unforeseen Incident well (#19); P0's trade of the damaged Shiden into the Guncannon (#29) was good; P1's second Jaburo (#41) replaced an undamaged base to turn a shield into a card (it drew the Amuro that enabled lethal), a defensible aggressive choice, not reported. Mulligans and the choose-first decision were not judged.

findings.better: develop, e.g. GD02-058 Ryusei-Go + pair ST05-011 Akihiro Altland (linked, Tekkadan) and attack a rested Zaku II, or ST05-015 Isaribi + GD02-054 Barbatos 1st Form
findings.reason: P0 had no base (its EX Base was destroyed), only a 0-AP Mobile Worker, both enemy Zakus were rested, and it held four affordable Lv3 cards but no instant-speed card to keep mana for. Skipping the turn's development is a clear tempo loss.

findings.better: attack the rested ST05-003 CGS Mobile Worker+Mikazuki (HP1/3, AP2) with GD01-035 Zaku II [61]
findings.reason: P0 had 0 active resources, so the result was certain: P1's vanilla 1-cost Zaku is traded for a unit carrying a pilot, with no unit of P1's left rested afterwards. Holding back kept P1's units unattackable, so arguable.

findings.played: Schuzrum-Galluss (#36) and then Gelgoog (#37) both attacked the player (destroyed Isaribi HP3 and one shield)
findings.better: attack the rested GD05-060 Gundam Flauros+Akihiro (AP6, HP4) with one of the AP4 units and the player with the other
findings.reason: P0 had 0 open resources; a 2-cost vanilla unit (AP4 = Flauros's HP) trades for P0's 4-cost Flauros plus pilot, leaving P0 with no units (Barbatos 2nd had just died to Rick Dom). Instead Flauros survived and killed Schuzrum+Marida the next turn. The cost would only have been one less shield damage.

findings.played: Ryusei-Go's discard: discard GD05-117 Become a Shield
findings.better: discard ST05-015 Isaribi and keep Become a Shield, Mobile Worker and Mikazuki
findings.reason: P0 (1 shield, no base, 5 resources left) faced three attackers (Kshatriya+FF, Zee Zulu 2/2, rested Gelgoog HP2/3); P1's only hand card was the Sinanju revealed earlier, with 1 open resource. With Become a Shield kept there is a deterministic survival line: deploy Mobile Worker; pair Mikazuki with Ryusei-Go (linked) pinging Mobile Worker and Zee Zulu; Become a Shield pinging Mobile Worker and Zee Zulu (Zee Zulu dies); linked Ryusei-Go (AP4) trades with the rested Gelgoog. That leaves P1 one attacker against P0's shield. Discarding the only removal card (rather than the base, which here only swaps the last shield for a 5-HP base Kshatriya kills in one hit) gave up that line. P0 lost the next turn.

findings.played: Mikazuki's When Paired 1 damage to GD01-044 Kshatriya (HP6 to 5)
findings.better: 1 damage to GD01-059 Zee Zulu (HP2 to 1)
findings.reason: Taking Kshatriya from 6 to 5 HP had no follow-up; Gelgoog would die to Ryusei-Go's attack anyway; Zee Zulu at HP1 could be finished by any further ping. The Isaribi played next drew another Become a Shield, which with Zee Zulu at HP1 would have allowed killing Zee Zulu and Gelgoog and surviving. P0 could not know the draw, so arguable.

findings.played: activate ST05-003 CGS Mobile Worker (rest it; 1 damage and AP+1 to its only possible target, itself)
findings.reason: Mobile Worker was deployed this turn and not linked, so it cannot attack, and no damaged-unit synergy was on board. The activation only dealt 1 damage to P0's own unit and rested it, making it attackable. There was no benefit.

items.notes: The Kshatriya ping choice by P1 (#56-#57: the active Barbatos 1st, then trading Char's Zaku into the rested Barbatos 2nd) was good, not a mistake. P1's Zeon Remnant Forces at #80 was irrelevant (lethal already on the stack), not reported. P0 using all three units on the player at turn 9 (#29-#31) left them exposed; a judgement call, not reported.

findings.played: attack the player with GD01-031 Gelgoog (one shield)
findings.better: attack the rested GD03-056 Gundam Barbatos Adapt (AP2, HP3/4) with Gelgoog (AP4, HP3)
findings.reason: P1 had 0 open resources and no active blocker, so Gelgoog would destroy Adapt and survive at HP1. Instead Adapt lived and hit P0's shield the next turn, while Gelgoog died to Barbatos 2nd anyway. The kill was free; the shield is the only thing given up, so arguable.

findings.played: end_main with GD01-035 Zaku II (2/2) and GD04-040 Schuzrum-Galluss (4/3) still active and able to attack
findings.better: attack the rested Barbatos Adapt (HP3) with Schuzrum and the player with Zaku II
findings.reason: Both players had 0 active resources, so no tricks were possible, and P0 has no blockers, so keeping units active defends nothing. Schuzrum into Adapt either destroys it (Schuzrum survives at HP1) or Schwalbe Graze blocks and trades (a 2-cost for P1's 3-cost blocker). Zaku into the player either takes a shield (P1 at 2) or is blocked and trades with Schwalbe. Every outcome is better than passing. P1 won the next turn with one attacker to spare (it even sent Adapt into a unit); removing Adapt, or trading off Schwalbe, would have removed that margin.

items.notes: Not reported as findings: P1's Mobile Worker line at turn 5 (#16-#24, losing a Mobile Worker plus Become a Shield to kill a 1-cost Zaku) is poor value but defensible; P1 attacking with its Blocker Shiden at turn 9 (#49) and Adapt attacking Zee Zulu instead of the player during the lethal turn (#85) are judgement calls, and lethal still held. P0's turn-2 decision not to spend its EX resource on a second 1-drop (#6) is defensible, since the EX resource counts toward Lv.

findings.played: pair GD01-093 Marida Cruz with GD01-035 Zaku II (no link condition)
findings.better: pair Marida with GD02-048 Zaku III (Sleeves) (link: Neo Zeon)
findings.reason: On Zaku II, Marida's 【During Link】【Attack】 ping can never trigger. On Zaku III she links, pings an enemy unit of Lv3 or lower on attack (e.g. GM to HP1) and raises its 1 HP to 2. Same cost; the stat spread is the only argument for Zaku II.

findings.played: GD01-115 Zeon Remnant Forces: 1 damage to ST01-001 Gundam+Amuro (HP3/5, <Repair 2>)
findings.better: 1 damage to ST01-005 GM (HP2/2, no Repair), or hold the command
findings.reason: The Gundam recovers 2 HP at the end of P1's next turn, before P0 can attack again, so the damage was healed (HP4/5 at #49); it only discouraged that Gundam from fighting during P1's turn. The GM had no Repair, so it would have stayed at HP1 for good.

findings.played: end_main with ST01-005 GM (AP4) active and able to attack
findings.reason: P0 had no base, no blockers (its only unit was a Zaku III) and 0 active resources, so the attack takes a shield for free. The Jaburo activation was useless (every P1 attacker had already been used). The only consequence of GM being rested afterwards is that P0's Zaku III could trade into a 1-cost GM instead of into a Gundam, which is good for P1.

findings.better: pair ST01-012 Thoroughly Damaged (pilot Hayato, White Base Team) with the just-deployed GD01-004 Guncannon (link), then attack the player
findings.reason: P0 had no units and no base, so the linked Guncannon's attack would take another shield. Spending Thoroughly Damaged as a pilot gives up its 1-damage command mode, so arguable.

items.notes: Not reported: P1 not attacking with Guncannon at turn 6 (#18), because it would have been exposed to a trade with Zaku III; P1 replacing its undamaged Jaburo with Davao at turn 16 (#69), which traded a shield for a card while ahead; P0's Zeon Remnant Forces on Guntank at turn 17 (#80), low value but not wrong. P0's turn 11 (#49-#53), trading two Zaku IIIs for both Amuro-linked Gundams, was good.
